mods.name: Board notes (knowledge packs for the shipped boards)
mods.author: Biga73 (idea) · DEADBOARD
mods.description: An example data mod: a knowledge pack for every board that ships with DEADBOARD. Rails, where each one comes from, what to expect at which pin, and what a low reading usually means, each marked documented, derived or estimated. The packs describe the working board and point at likely causes, the way the board's hints do; they don't name the planted faults. Based on the device knowledge pack RFC by Biga73.

mods.name: Ideal DC solver (example code mod)
mods.author: DEADBOARD
mods.description: An example code mod: a small DC solver in plain JavaScript (resistors, batteries, switches, fuses, diodes and LEDs with a fixed forward voltage). Copy it to start your own engine. It runs in DEADBOARD's sandbox and needs no permissions.

mods.name: Local coach (example code mod)
mods.author: DEADBOARD
mods.description: An example code mod: ask a language model about the board on the bench. It keeps an index of the board and sends only what the question needs: the parts and nets it names, their neighbours, the voltages, per-part currents, test results and readings. Local by default (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM: any OpenAI-compatible server); OpenRouter is opt-in and asks for that one site. The panel says when data leaves the computer, the key is kept in memory only, and any part or net name the board doesn't have is removed from the answer.

mods.name: Night light extras
mods.author: DEADBOARD
mods.description: An example mod that builds on other mods: a knowledge pack and a puzzle for the starter kit's night light, and one more note for the built-in Ghost Short challenge. No board files of its own.

mods.name: Repair lab extras
mods.author: DEADBOARD
mods.description: An example data mod: a new fault type (salt-water damage), a budget multimeter, one more diagnostic rule for «Where to look?», and a puzzle on the built-in voltage divider that uses the new fault.

mods.name: Starter kit
